title: The Last Bookshop
subtitle: A light under the door. Three ways into morning.
description: Step into a strange, warmly lit bookshop and read an original branching story in 22 scenes. Explore six invented books, carry useful discoveries, and choose one of three consequence-driven endings.
medium: A bookcase, a reading room, and an original branching story
instruction: Come in out of the rain, read a book, and decide what becomes of the shop.
